floor_history.headline: Recon s1: full scheduler-mechanism map — slot-3 addiu is LUID-forced (combine pins it to the call site); 2 lever families killed; jump2-after-sched2 pass-order fact opens the multi-block-body frontier

frontier.hypothesis: The original loop body was multi-block at scheduling time (a0-set in its own early block, blocking the combine merge cross-block); jump2 — which runs after sched2 — deleted the extra control flow, producing the addiu-at-top order no single-block schedule can emit
frontier.mechanism: toplev.c pass order: no jump pass between reload and sched2; jump_optimize(insns,1,1,0) after sched2 deletes no-op moves, branches-to-next, unreferenced labels before reorg
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate natural spellings whose in-body control flow survives to sched2 but is jump2-deletable (no-op-move-after-coalescing branches, threaded labels); sandbox each; check target preheader bytes around 0x80069C58 for entry-path constraints

frontier.hypothesis: The family-wide source idiom is recoverable from siblings: a matched func_8007352C caller whose TARGET also has addiu-at-distance reveals the exact C shape
frontier.mechanism: Same compiler + same idiom family (EnvA work-struct at sp+0x18) must reproduce the placement; straight-line sibling blocks (func_8005C8A8) are a simpler instance of the same anomaly
frontier.next_probe: objdump build/text1b.o for each matched caller (~12986/13086/13172-95/17248/17411), compare emitted addiu position vs their target asm; if any target shows addiu-at-distance, extract the idiom and transplant
